_comment: Whether each box can actually be bought, so collection tools count only what a player could own. Read off the publisher's own store catalogue (queti-tectonics.com/collections/frontpage) on 2026-08-10. 'available' = listed and buyable there; 'coming' = listed as Coming Soon; 'unreleased' = not listed at all. Retailers sometimes have stock the publisher's own store does not, so 'coming' is a soft no rather than a hard one. OTTO updates this as boxes arrive.
_why: The whole GoF range is unreleased, so its cards must not count towards 'what can I buy' figures even though our card data has them. Same for anything else not yet on sale.
_shape: boxes maps a box key to { status, product, checked }. status is available | coming | unreleased.

COMBAT_RAID._note: OTTO expects a copy in the week of 2026-08-10, so retailers have it before the publisher's own store does.

GOF_CORE._note: No GoF product of any kind appears in the publisher's catalogue. The faction's cards exist in the parts lists (v1.021) but nothing that contains them is on sale.

LAB_TRIAL_UN_OCTOPUS._note: Trial-model cards; never seen on the store.

GAME_PACK._note: Promotional/event cards rather than a retail box.

UNSALE._note: Named for it: content the publisher does not sell. Already excluded everywhere.
